import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Convert Dt_Customer to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate the age of customers
df['Age'] = 2023 - df['Year_Birth']

# Create a new column for total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds']

# Create a boxplot of total spending by education level
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='Education', y='Total_Spending', data=df, palette='viridis')
plt.title('Total Spending by Education Level')
plt.xlabel('Education Level')
plt.ylabel('Total Spending')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
